left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients 18 years old and older at the time of consent

right.raw_text: -  ASA status I, II, or III

-  Scheduled for surgical  [OR] and non-surgical procedures scheduled under general anesthesia (Common procedures include but are not restricted to tonsillectomy, [OR]  adenoidectomy, [OR]  urological procedures, [OR]  dental rehabilitation, [OR]  orthopedic procedures, [OR]  biopsies, [OR]  audiogram, [OR]  nuclear scans, [OR]  gastroscopy, [OR]  colonoscopy, etc

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Any deformities  [OR] or devices that may prevent application of EEG Sensor to forehead with a proper fit
-  Subjects deemed not suitable for study at the discretion of the investigator
